title: The Mass Effect as time-scale law
statement: The Mass Effect (the Law of Masstime) is the corpus's named articulation of the canon's compressed time-mass sentence: the subjective experience of time scales with the mass and complexity of the living form across the infinite hierarchy of scales, so that larger-scale beings live proportionally slower — the corpus develops the canon's one sentence into a framework concept, at speculative grade, and keeps it strictly inside the fractal frame it articulates.

includes: The canonical seed: the time-inversely-proportional-to-mass sentence carried at the canon's level in woh-claim-0023
The corpus development: the named law, its scaling articulation, and its role in making the fractal frame's living-scales picture coherent (a galaxy-scale being's 'moment' spanning our aeons)
The development disclosure: one canonical sentence, corpus-articulated — the ratio of seed to construct is stated plainly
excludes: Any claim of relativistic or biological-scaling support; physical time dilation and metabolic scaling laws are different phenomena, and borrowing their vocabulary as evidence is excluded
Quantitative form; no exponent or constant is asserted
Application to terrestrial biology's actual scaling literature, which measures different quantities
The frame itself, which is woh-claim-0023's

source_references.locator: The time-mass sentence within the scale teachings

alternatives.statement: The law dresses one aphoristic sentence in physical-law vocabulary; nothing lawlike (form, quantity, test) is present.
Where the idea touches real science (metabolic scaling, subjective-time research), the measured relationships are unrelated to the claim; adjacency is being mistaken for articulation.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0023 is revised or retired.
The canon's fuller context changes the sentence's reading.
Public prose begins citing physics or biology as support, or asserting quantitative form, both of which this record excludes.
